coldWarmActionLoad.interpretation: Measured click-to-active session readiness and application queue byte counters in the current local browser. These are not HTTP wire-byte timing or GPU/VRAM measurements.

repeatedRouteHighWater.interpretation: Observed after the nerve-search/back-to-muscle route; additional cached content stayed bounded during this run.

runtimeProfile.comparison: The full moving arm context adds two visible source instances and 10264 displayed triangles to the preserved baseline frame. Shared source geometry buffers, app loaded bytes and motion payload bytes did not increase in the same 390px cold/warm motion run. Renderer CPU P95 increased by about 0.2ms in this sample; frame interval P95 increased by 1.9ms, with no observed queue, cache eviction or load failure. This is a small measured timing change, not a device-wide performance guarantee.
